scope_boundaries.cyclic_negative: Unary-only feasible-set propagation is insufficient on cyclic parity networks when cycle correlation/parity is discarded.
scope_boundaries.eta: eta=2q-L-U is the unique affine-linear translation-covariant endpoint-swap-odd carrier up to scale in the proved class, but its sign/orientation does not by itself select an up/down branch.
scope_boundaries.gauge: Global complement is a symmetry of relative XOR constraints, but physical/observable gauge equivalence is not established.
scope_boundaries.initial_selector: No independently justified absolute singleton anchor is supplied by the bare Stage-Q substrate; the absolute initial branch remains nonidentified.
scope_boundaries.relational_law: BRC relative-constraint synchronization is established within the frozen pairwise-XOR synchronization class; it is not promoted as a universal theorem that every future BRC mechanism is pairwise XOR.
scope_boundaries.tree_fixed_point: Exact message-passing/fixed-point theorem is scoped to finite acyclic pairwise-XOR factor trees with relation-preserving messages and back-substitution.
